sections.name: Home threshold
sections.development: Introduce the guitar contour immediately; piano gives only a small harmonic frame.
sections.handoff: Guitar continues into the first full refrain.

sections.name: Home refrain 1
sections.development: Plain full melody over a small brush pulse; nylon and producer rest.
sections.handoff: Brushes withdraw for the verse’s frame-drum identity.

sections.name: Verse 1
sections.development: Two written eight-bar sentences, with a lighter second answer. Piano rests so the guitar chords have room.
sections.handoff: The frame drum ends its response before the refrain pickup.

sections.name: Home refrain 2
sections.development: The familiar hook returns with piano body and a restrained electronic tail.
sections.handoff: Guitar finishes and hands the bridge to piano.

sections.name: Piano bridge
sections.development: A complete lyrical keyboard statement with bass; all drum layers rest.
sections.handoff: Piano leaves the next phrase to nylon.

sections.name: Guitar room dialogue
sections.development: A written nylon answer and sparse piano response develop the home material.
sections.handoff: Sunbird returns after the dialogue resolves.

sections.name: Verse 2
sections.development: Change voicing and phrase endings; piano enters only in the second half’s gaps.
sections.handoff: A four-bar preparation thins the texture.

sections.name: Homecoming preparation
sections.development: An intimate harmonic lift preserves the home feeling.
sections.handoff: Piano releases before the guitar hook.

sections.name: Final home refrain
sections.development: First eight bars are familiar; second eight develop the answer and final cadence, with one chord player thinning at each guitar phrase.
sections.handoff: Brushes and electronic accents leave before the coda.

sections.name: Home coda
sections.development: A deliberate resolving phrase, gentle bass ending and natural room decay.
sections.handoff: A completed song ending; a future runtime loop edit is separate.

references: DKC1 environmental contrast and motif memory; Bonobo ensemble production; performer-specific principles in the linked cue call sheet.
melody_adaptation: Original A/B pitches preserved; Sky 6/8 quarter-note phrasing expanded 4/3 into 4/4; Castle returns to original approved 3/4; Opera adds bounded cadence rolls.
mastering_plan: Measured part and group gain staging, native ReaEQ, quiet shared room, gentle 1.35:1 glue and measured album gain; native -2 dB peak guard; decoded OGG true-peak/DC/mono checks.
